title: Update Landing Page Features intro copy to mention admin approvals

requirements.summary: Revise the Landing Page Features section intro text to state that admins review/approve (admit) registered users before they can use RideBook, changing only the specified intro container and its paragraph.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the content within the selected Features Section intro container (and its paragraph) is changed; no other page sections/components are modified.
The updated copy clearly communicates that admins can review/approve registered users ("admit" users) before they can use the service.
All updated user-facing text is in English.
The app builds and the Landing Page renders without runtime errors.
